# CoMOR "Fairs in History" — fair calendars, France/Germany/Italy c. 1320–1630

## Source
- Public database: https://fairs-in-history.huma-num.fr (ANR/DFG project CoMOR,
  "Configurations of European Fairs"). Downloads page lists 102 datasets in 5
  categories; no registration. Downloaded all 18 fair_calendar collections as
  GeoJSON 2026-08-10 (unzipped; one folder per collection COLxxxx).

## Citation
Project CoMOR (dir. S. Rauch et al.), "Fairs in History" database,
huma-num. See de Gruyter chapter DOI 10.1515/9783111621296-018.

## Contents (fair_calendar exports)
1,700 dated fair-meeting events at 304 distinct places, each with
place_name_modern, historic name, lat/lon coordinates, exact DATE (to the day,
e.g. 1338-01-05 or 1576-02-02), duration, and source collection. Coverage:
France, southern Germany/Bavaria, Switzerland (Geneva), Savoy/Turin, northern
Italy, Luxembourg, Antwerp — i.e., precisely SOUTH of the Viabundus footprint.

## What it is / is not
Dated fair ACTIVITY (meetings attested in calendars, almanacs, toll accounts),
NOT fair-privilege grant dates. Usable as: (a) an "ever had an active fair by
year Y" indicator for southern cities (fills the n/c gap descriptively);
(b) cross-validation of Viabundus fair coverage in the overlap zone. Not
directly usable as a grant-date event study. Other categories (fair_references,
trade_data, networks) remain downloadable from the site if needed.
